response.justification: Bogdan shows strong distributed/high-throughput systems experience (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec) and current hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, the resume shows no Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have, and there's limited evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management, formal on-call/incident ownership, or sustained Staff-level technical strategy leadership — his career is largely generalist/full-stack across many companies with relatively short tenures.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, matching the AI-native engineering mindset
Broad systems thinking across web, mobile, embedded, and infra domains with multiple languages
concerns: No Python listed anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being a core must-have
Little explicit evidence of stakeholder management, agile ceremony leadership, or on-call/incident response ownership
Career pattern of frequent job changes and generalist/freelance work dilutes depth of sustained Staff-level technical strategy impact
